boundary_decision.rationale: The aggregate root is one stock-affecting movement assertion. Request, physical execution, observation, authoritative posting and resulting stock position remain distinguishable and independently sourced.

decisions.rationale: The model owns movement identity, asserted transition, evidence references and correction lineage rather than stock balance or warehouse workflow.
A movement references before-and-after inventory positions, but an event is not automatically contained by the position aggregate.

decisions.concept: Request plan execution observation posting and balance
decisions.rationale: They may occur at different times under different authorities and must not share one status or timestamp.
Product, lot, serial and handling-unit identities remain external while the movement owns the scoped quantity assertion.
Locations, positions, ownership, custody, availability, quality and disposition are independently typed before-and-after references.
Shipment grouping and cross-organizational trace graphs remain external even when they trigger or evidence an inventory movement.
Vercy records posting identity, authority, time and result reference but does not mutate an inventory or accounting ledger.
Prior assertions remain immutable and resolvable; correction or reversal creates a linked successor or compensating record.

decisions.concept: GS1 UBL UN/CEFACT and ISA-95 projections
decisions.rationale: The sources cover different visibility, fulfilment, inventory-report and manufacturing-integration views and none is universal ledger authority.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without acquiring new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-FLW-012 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-OBJ-020 remains a required typed reference rather than an approved parent until joint boundary review.

Boundary hold: product, lot, serial, handling unit, location, stock position, order, task, shipment, trace, ledger, valuation, accounting, document, observation, incident and evidence remain external masters.
Assertion-kind hold: request, plan, reservation, physical execution, observation, posting, balance, correction and reconciliation must remain distinguishable.
Authority hold: authoritative posting, reversal and resulting balance require the external inventory master or ledger authority.
Terminology hold: movement, transfer, transaction, issue, receipt, adjustment, task and posting are profile-specific terms.
Profile hold: warehouse, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, customs, dangerous-goods, safety, accounting, valuation, privacy, licensing and retention profiles need independent validation.
Evidence hold: one scan, count, document, shipment event or posting reference does not alone prove balance, ownership, custody, availability, quality or financial value.
Interoperability hold: all GS1, UBL, UN/CEFACT, ISA-95, IEC 62264, unit, provenance and quality projections require exact release pins, conformance tests and semantic-loss declarations.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal industry, legal, operational or accounting coverage.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
